ability.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
ability.description: Gains no new weapon or armor proficiencies.

ability.name: Spells per Day
ability.description: Advances existing divine spellcasting class by one level per thaumaturgist level.

ability.name: Improved Ally
ability.description: When casting a planar ally spell, pay half the usual offering or payment for the creature's service.

ability.name: Extended Summoning
ability.description: All summon monster and summon nature's ally spells have their duration doubled.

ability.name: Contingent Conjuration
ability.description: Can set a summon monster spell to trigger automatically under specific conditions, as contingency.

ability.name: Planar Cohort
ability.description: Can use planar ally to call an outsider to serve permanently as a cohort.
